content: Root cause: The bug was caused by the failure to check the validity of the VMCS-link pointer before performing a VMWRITE operation in VMX non-root operation. According to the Intel Software Developer's Manual (SDM), an invalid VMCS-link pointer should result in a VMfailInvalid error before checking the validity of the VMCS field. The original implementation did not enforce this check consistently, leading to potential invalid operations and incorrect behavior when the VMCS-link pointer was set to -1ull. The patch corrects this by ensuring that both handle_vmwrite and handle_vmread functions check the VMCS-link pointer validity before proceeding with their respective operations.
